entries.note: Independent audit (not the translator) of cli.vault at source hash 88cd0862f4e2: 24/24 keys present in en order; ICU placeholder names/kinds parity with en ({endpoint}, {org}, {minutes}, {until}, {url}); every backticked command (`lop vault connect`, `lop login radient`, `lop team-bridge setup`) byte-identical; Ctrl+C, Radient Vault, Radient Team, Local Operator, JSON and 600 kept verbatim; {url} stays last in revoke_hint; NFC, no bidi/zero-width controls; repo check.py --catalogues-only 0 problems. Safety meaning checked against en .context.json: compare tells the person to check the 16 groups on the approval page BEFORE approving and never claims the harness verified anything; unavailable/not_team carry no up-sell or retry advice; connected_until bounds READ access at {until}; disconnected/revoke_hint keep local-key removal distinct from console revocation. Glossary: agent, approvals, credentials, team plan and 'agent messages' (matches cli.team_bridge / cli.team_bridge_hold) checked against this locale's catalogues and style guide; 'vault' and 'fingerprint' have no prior catalogue rendering, so this namespace sets them. Register lowercase вы; 'одобрение' per glossary note 3; «компьютер» for machine matches the catalogue majority. Findings 0 blocker / 0 major / 3 minor: (m, fixed) unavailable 'Доступ агентов пока недоступен' and status_open 'Доступ … доступен' are the доступ/доступен tautology — now 'Доступ агентов пока не открыт.' / 'Доступ агентов к Radient Vault открыт в {org}.' Minor deferred: endpoint is rendered 'точка подключения' in key_heading while wire.settings keeps the Latin 'endpoint'; not a glossary row and the bep_ id beside it disambiguates, so left for a glossary decision. Unresolved blocker/major: 0. Plurals one/few/many/other (genitive after 'до': минуты/минут/минут/минуты) rendered at 1/2/5/21/1000000. Single independent audit pass by a different agent on the SAME model family as the translator (anthropic/claude-opus-5-5); no cross-model second audit; no native-speaker or rendered-frame certification. Corrections were applied by the auditor at the manager's instruction (team radientdev); the corrected strings have no second independent audit, and a separate re-audit of them is recommended.
